desc: The Squid is known as the perfect everyday carry knife, expertly combining simplicity, usability and performance. Despite being the smallest knife in the family, the Squid Compact is packed with advanced features. Assisted Opening propels the blade open with a flick of the thumb and IKBS bearings ensure smooth opening and closing every time. The high-carbon steel blade is easy to sharpen and the stainless steel handle not only provides strength to endure for a lifetime, it gives the knife some reassuring heft in your hand. The low-profile clip lets you slip it comfortably and securely into your pocket or use the lanyard hole to attach it to a keychain or fob.
